detected_fault: Monitor flickering and flashing at 4K resolution (3840 x 2160), with a drop to 30Hz.
suggested_solution: Consider using a docking station that supports DisplayPort mode and has two DisplayPorts (USB-C/Thunderbolt). Some popular options include: Dell USB 3.0 Ultra HD/4K Triple Display Docking Station (D3100) alternatives CalDigit TS3 Plus Razer Core X Chroma
If possible, consider plugging the monitor directly into the laptop using an HDMI 2.0 port.
Ensure that the resolution is set to a compatible setting (e.g., 3840 x 2160 at 60Hz) and adjust as needed.
